Package io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.api.template

Class TemplateManager

java.lang.Object
io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.api.AbstractManager
io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.api.template.TemplateManager
public class TemplateManager extends AbstractManager
GeoServer Template REST API manager.

Verified against: GeoServer 2.28.2 / 2026-04-02 (Kartoza Docker kartoza/geoserver)

Source:

  • src/restconfig/.../org/geoserver/rest/catalog/TemplateController.java
  • Template format: FreeMarker (.ftl) — used to customize GeoServer WFS/WMS responses
  • Storage paths in GeoServer Data Directory:
    • Root: workspaces/{templateName}.ftl
    • Workspace: workspaces/{ws}/{templateName}.ftl
    • DataStore: workspaces/{ws}/{ds}/{templateName}.ftl
    • FeatureType: workspaces/{ws}/{ds}/{ft}/{templateName}.ftl
    • CoverageStore: workspaces/{ws}/{cs}/{templateName}.ftl
    • Coverage: workspaces/{ws}/{cs}/{coverage}/{templateName}.ftl

Endpoints

 POST  /rest/templates/{name}
